description: Create design. Create a mail design from custom HTML or an AI prompt. The response includes the design and its HTML; no polling is required. Requires user approval and confirmed=true before changes or credit use. Writes are never retried automatically.

auto_publish.description: Automatically publish the design after creation

html_back.description: Custom HTML for the back side

html_front.description: Custom HTML for the front side (alternative to prompt)

include_street_view.description: Include a Street View image placeholder in the design

orientation.description: Postcard orientation. Portrait is temporarily unavailable.

prompt.description: AI prompt to generate an HTML design. Returns immediately since HTML generation is fast.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user approves this change or credit use.

name: dealmachine_post_mail_designs
